senses.en: a written or spoken description of what happened
senses.pattern: an eyewitness account / give an account of / by all accounts
senses.example: The two witnesses gave very different [[accounts]] of how the accident on the bridge had happened.
senses.example_zh: 對於橋上那場事故的發生經過，兩名目擊者的說法大不相同。

senses.en: (account for) to form a particular part of a total
senses.pattern: account for 30% of / account for half of / account for a large share of
senses.example: Tourism [[accounts]] for nearly a third of the island's income, so every typhoon season worries local businesses.
senses.example_zh: 觀光業占該島收入將近三分之一，因此每到颱風季當地商家都很擔心。

senses.en: (account for) to give or be the reason for something
senses.pattern: account for the difference / account for the delay / hard to account for
senses.example: Researchers could not [[account]] for the sudden drop in the number of bees in the valley.
senses.example_zh: 研究人員無法解釋山谷裡蜜蜂數量為何突然減少。

gsat.sentence: Another [[account]] claims that David Jung, a Chinese immigrant living in Los Angeles, created the fortune cookie in 1918.
Today, tea can be drunk at any time of the day, and [[accounts]] for over two-fifths of all beverages consumed in Britain—with the exception of water.

senses.en: to be the same as or equal to something
senses.pattern: amount to cheating / amount to a refusal / amount to the same thing
senses.example: Copying a classmate's homework and handing it in as your own [[amounts]] to cheating.
senses.example_zh: 抄同學的作業再當成自己的交出去，就等同於作弊。

senses.en: to add up to a particular total
senses.pattern: amount to a total of / amount to millions / amount to very little
senses.example: Donations from students and parents [[amounted]] to nearly two million dollars by the end of the charity fair.
senses.example_zh: 到義賣會結束時，學生和家長的捐款總計達將近兩百萬元。

senses.en: an upper limit on prices, wages, or spending
senses.pattern: a price ceiling / set a ceiling on / raise the debt ceiling
senses.example: The government set a [[ceiling]] on rent increases to protect families from losing their homes.
senses.example_zh: 政府為租金漲幅設定上限，以免許多家庭失去住處。

senses.en: a small object believed to bring good luck
senses.pattern: a lucky charm / a good-luck charm / wear a charm / a charm bracelet
senses.example: Before every exam, he touches the lucky [[charm]] his grandmother bought for him at a temple.
senses.example_zh: 每次考試前，他都會摸一摸奶奶在廟裡替他求來的護身符。
senses.note: work like a charm＝非常靈驗、有效

gsat.sentence: Other times, a magician may make you a magic [[charm]], or say a spell, to cure you.

senses.en: most important; highest in rank
senses.pattern: the chief cause / the chief reason / chief concern / chief engineer
senses.example: Lack of sleep is the [[chief]] cause of poor concentration among teenagers, the report says.
senses.example_zh: 報告指出，睡眠不足是青少年注意力不集中的主要原因。

gsat.sentence: Showing great talent in painting, Moran was soon hired as an illustrator at Scribner’s Monthly, and later appointed [[chief]] illustrator by age 34.
Seeing this, Brahma, the [[chief]] god, decided to take their divinity away from them and hide it where it could never be found.

senses.en: the general attitude or situation at a particular time
senses.pattern: the political climate / the economic climate / a climate of fear / in the current climate
senses.example: In the current economic [[climate]], many young graduates find it hard to get a full-time job.
senses.example_zh: 在目前的經濟形勢下，許多年輕畢業生很難找到全職工作。

gsat.sentence: Marian Anderson (1897-1993) was an African American woman who gained fame as a concert singer in this [[climate]] of racism.

senses.en: the fact of being with someone; people you are with
senses.pattern: keep sb company / enjoy sb's company / in the company of / good company
senses.example: I enjoyed her [[company]] on the long train ride, and the six hours passed quickly.
senses.example_zh: 漫長的火車旅程有她陪伴很愉快，六個小時一下就過了。
senses.note: 此義不可數；have company＝有客人

senses.en: a group of actors or dancers who perform together
senses.pattern: a theater company / a dance company / a touring company
senses.example: At eighteen, she joined a ballet [[company]] and performed on stages in over twenty countries.
senses.example_zh: 她十八歲時加入一個芭蕾舞團，在二十多個國家登台演出。

senses.en: people you know who can help you
senses.pattern: have connections / use one's connections / business connections / family connections
senses.example: He got the internship through his father's [[connections]] in the film industry, not through talent.
senses.example_zh: 他是靠父親在電影圈的人脈才得到實習機會，而不是靠才華。

senses.en: a train, bus, or plane that you change to
senses.pattern: miss one's connection / catch a connection / a connection to Paris
senses.example: Our first flight landed an hour late, so we missed our [[connection]] to Vancouver.
senses.example_zh: 我們的第一班飛機晚了一小時降落，因此錯過了飛往溫哥華的轉乘班次。

senses.en: a switch or device used to operate a machine
senses.pattern: at the controls / the volume control / a remote control
senses.example: The pilot stayed at the [[controls]] for ten hours as the plane crossed the stormy ocean.
senses.example_zh: 飛機飛越風暴中的海洋時，飛行員在操縱裝置前守了整整十個小時。

senses.en: a group used for comparison in an experiment
senses.pattern: a control group / serve as a control / a control experiment
senses.example: Half of the plants received extra light, while the other half served as a [[control]].
senses.example_zh: 半數的植物接受額外光照，另一半則作為對照組。

gsat.sentence: He linked all of this to a device shaped like a spinning wheel, with a foot [[control]] that turned the rod, making the glass hemispheres rotate.
Moreover, a number of firms are creating cars that drive themselves to a chosen destination without a human at the [[controls]].

senses.en: to join or combine one thing with another
senses.pattern: coupled with sth / couple A with B / be closely coupled to sth
senses.example: Heavy rain, [[coupled]] with strong winds, forced the airport to cancel more than fifty flights.
senses.example_zh: 豪雨加上強風，迫使機場取消了五十多個航班。

senses.en: a steady flow of water or air
senses.pattern: ocean currents / air currents / a strong current / swim against the current
senses.example: The little paper boat was carried downstream by the [[current]] and soon disappeared from view.
senses.example_zh: 小紙船被水流帶往下游，很快就從視線中消失。

senses.en: a flow of electricity through a wire
senses.pattern: an electric current / a weak current / pass a current through
senses.example: A weak electric [[current]] passes through the wire when both metals touch the lemon juice.
senses.example_zh: 當兩種金屬都碰到檸檬汁時，微弱的電流便會通過電線。

gsat.sentence: During different tides, [[currents]] may change from one direction to the other.
In 2020, Petur Oddsson, a power station worker in Iceland, was struck by a 60,000-volt [[current]].

senses.en: made specially for one particular person or purpose
senses.pattern: custom furniture / a custom suit / custom-made shoes
senses.example: The carpenter built a [[custom]] desk to fit the narrow corner of my bedroom.
senses.example_zh: 木匠為我訂做了一張書桌，剛好放得進臥室的狹窄角落。

senses.en: the place where officials check goods entering a country
senses.pattern: go through customs / clear customs / a customs officer
senses.example: All passengers must go through [[customs]] and declare any food they are carrying.
senses.example_zh: 所有旅客都必須通過海關，並申報隨身攜帶的任何食物。

gsat.sentence: I work there at the [[customs]].

senses.en: to get something you deserve because of your actions
senses.pattern: earn respect / earn a reputation / earn sb's trust / earn praise
senses.example: Her honesty and hard work [[earned]] her the trust of everyone in the office.
senses.example_zh: 她的誠實與努力為她贏得了辦公室裡每個人的信任。

senses.en: (of money) to produce interest or profit
senses.pattern: earn interest / earn a profit / earn a good return
senses.example: Money kept in this savings account [[earns]] about two percent interest a year.
senses.example_zh: 存在這個儲蓄帳戶裡的錢，每年大約可生百分之二的利息。

gsat.sentence: Be modest and hard-working to [[earn]] respect from other people.

Zoe was rather healthy when she was found, and once under the care of the orphanage she was very happy, consuming six gallons of vitamin-rich milk a day and [[earning]] a reputation as a confident, naughty and mischievous youngster.

senses.en: to remove everything that is inside something
senses.pattern: empty the trash / empty one's pockets / empty a bottle
senses.example: The guard asked every visitor to [[empty]] their pockets before walking through the gate.
senses.example_zh: 警衛要求每位訪客在通過大門前先清空口袋。

senses.en: (of a river) to flow into a sea or lake
senses.pattern: empty into the sea / empty into the lake / empty into the Pacific
senses.example: The river flows through three countries before it finally [[empties]] into the sea.
senses.example_zh: 這條河流經三個國家，最後注入大海。

senses.en: having no real meaning, value, or sincerity
senses.pattern: empty promises / empty words / an empty threat
senses.example: The coach's warning turned out to be an [[empty]] threat; nobody was ever punished for being late.
senses.example_zh: 教練的警告結果只是空洞的威脅，從來沒有人因遲到而受罰。

senses.en: to be forgotten or not noticed by someone
senses.pattern: escape sb's notice / escape sb's attention / sb's name escapes me
senses.example: I know I have met that actor before, but his name [[escapes]] me at the moment.
senses.example_zh: 我知道我以前見過那位演員，但我一時忘記他的名字了。
senses.note: 主詞是事物；不用進行式和被動

senses.en: a way of forgetting your worries for a while
senses.pattern: an escape from reality / a form of escape / a temporary escape
senses.example: For many teenagers, reading fantasy novels is an [[escape]] from the pressure of endless tests.
senses.example_zh: 對許多青少年來說，讀奇幻小說是逃避現實的方式，能暫時擺脫考不完的試所帶來的壓力。

gsat.sentence: For a temporary [[escape]], she joined a small writers’ group, in which each member was required to bring a story or poem for discussion.

senses.en: belonging to the same group or sharing the same situation
senses.pattern: fellow students / fellow passengers / fellow citizens / fellow workers
senses.example: When the bus broke down, she chatted with her [[fellow]] passengers while waiting for help.
senses.example_zh: 公車拋錨時，她一邊等待救援，一邊和同車的乘客聊天。

senses.en: a person in the same group or situation as you
senses.pattern: play with one's fellows / be respected by one's fellows / cooperate with one's fellows
senses.example: Young children learn how to share and take turns by playing with their [[fellows]].
senses.example_zh: 幼童藉由和同伴玩耍，學會分享與輪流。
senses.note: 常用複數；另指大學研究員（research fellow）

gsat.sentence: In teaching young players to cooperate with their [[fellows]] on the practice field, the game shows them the necessity of teamwork in society.

senses.en: to work properly or serve a particular purpose
senses.pattern: function as / function properly / function normally
senses.example: The old church now [[functions]] as a community library where children gather after school.
senses.example_zh: 這座老教堂現在充當社區圖書館，孩子們放學後都會聚在那裡。

senses.en: a formal social event or official ceremony
senses.pattern: a social function / attend a function / an official function
senses.example: The hotel's ballroom is often rented out for weddings, charity dinners, and other formal [[functions]].
senses.example_zh: 這家飯店的宴會廳常出租舉辦婚禮、慈善晚宴和其他正式聚會。

gsat.sentence: They [[functioned]] as a funeral offering shown upon the altars of the gods.
John’s clock is not [[functioning]] properly. The alarm rings even when it’s not set to go off.

senses.en: to understand or believe something from what you hear
senses.pattern: I gather that… / from what I can gather / as far as I can gather
senses.example: I [[gather]] from your email that you would like to change the date of the interview.
senses.example_zh: 從你的電子郵件，我推斷你想更改面試的日期。

senses.en: to gradually increase in speed, force, or strength
senses.pattern: gather speed / gather momentum / gather strength / gather pace
senses.example: The train slowly left the platform and [[gathered]] speed as it headed out of the city.
senses.example_zh: 火車緩緩駛離月台，出城時速度逐漸增加。

senses.en: to attract someone's attention or interest
senses.pattern: grab sb's attention / grab the headlines / grab the audience
senses.example: A good title should [[grab]] readers' attention and make them want to read on.
senses.example_zh: 好的標題應該吸引讀者的注意，讓他們想繼續讀下去。

senses.en: to quickly get or have food, sleep, or a thing
senses.pattern: grab a bite / grab a coffee / grab some sleep / grab a seat
senses.example: We only had ten minutes between classes, so we [[grabbed]] a sandwich at the school store.
senses.example_zh: 我們課間只有十分鐘，所以在合作社匆匆買了個三明治吃。

gsat.sentence: So, [[grab]] a copy and start learning how you can reduce stress in your life.

senses.en: low in rank or social position
senses.pattern: humble origins / a humble background / of humble birth
senses.example: Born into a [[humble]] family of farmers, she later became the country's most respected judge.
senses.example_zh: 她出身卑微的農家，後來成為該國最受敬重的法官。

senses.en: simple and plain, not large or special
senses.pattern: a humble home / humble beginnings / a humble meal
senses.example: The famous chef started his career at a [[humble]] noodle stand beside the train station.
senses.example_zh: 這位名廚的事業是從火車站旁一個簡陋的麵攤起步的。

gsat.sentence: They often concern very strong or clever people who come from [[humble]] backgrounds.
But the knife had [[humble]] beginnings.

senses.en: bad or harmful
senses.pattern: ill effects / ill will / ill feeling / ill fortune
senses.example: Fortunately, the children suffered no [[ill]] effects from drinking the dirty water.
senses.example_zh: 幸好孩子們喝了髒水後，並未出現任何不良的影響。
senses.note: 複數名詞 ills 指弊病，如 social ills

senses.en: badly; hardly
senses.pattern: can ill afford / speak ill of / ill-treated / ill-prepared
senses.example: With exams only a week away, we can [[ill]] afford to waste another evening.
senses.example_zh: 離考試只剩一週，我們幾乎不能再浪費任何一個晚上了。

senses.en: the act of bringing something into use for the first time
senses.pattern: the introduction of new technology / since its introduction / the introduction of a new system
senses.example: The [[introduction]] of electronic textbooks has made students' schoolbags much lighter than before.
senses.example_zh: 電子教科書的引進，讓學生的書包比以前輕了許多。
senses.note: 動詞 introduce 亦有「引進」之義

senses.en: a book or course that explains a subject to beginners
senses.pattern: an introduction to psychology / a good introduction to / a brief introduction to
senses.example: This short book is an excellent [[introduction]] to astronomy for curious teenagers.
senses.example_zh: 這本小書是絕佳的天文學入門書，很適合好奇的青少年。
senses.note: 常用 an introduction to＋學科

gsat.sentence: Since its [[introduction]] in the early 20th century, the headgear has saved countless lives and is considered the number one safety tool for construction workers.

senses.en: to make clothes smooth with a hot iron
senses.pattern: iron a shirt / iron your uniform / do the ironing
senses.example: He carefully [[ironed]] his white shirt the night before the job interview.
senses.example_zh: 面試前一晚，他仔細地熨燙了他的白襯衫。
senses.note: n. 熨斗；iron out 解決（問題）

senses.en: very strong and determined; very strict
senses.pattern: an iron will / iron discipline / rule with an iron fist
senses.example: It took an [[iron]] will for her to finish the marathon with an injured knee.
senses.example_zh: 她憑著鋼鐵般堅強的意志，才帶著受傷的膝蓋跑完馬拉松。

senses.en: the amount of matter in an object
senses.pattern: the mass of an object / body mass / muscle mass / mass and weight
senses.example: An astronaut's [[mass]] stays the same on the moon, although his weight becomes much smaller.
senses.example_zh: 太空人的質量在月球上維持不變，但他的重量卻小得多。

senses.en: a large amount of something with no clear shape
senses.pattern: a cold air mass / a mass of clouds / a mass of rock / a solid mass
senses.example: A cold air [[mass]] from the north will bring lower temperatures to the island this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 來自北方的冷氣團本週末將為島上帶來較低的氣溫。

senses.en: a person who is born good at something
senses.pattern: be a natural / a natural at tennis / a natural on stage
senses.example: Sophie had never acted before, but the director said she was a [[natural]] on stage.
senses.example_zh: 蘇菲以前從未演過戲，但導演說她在舞台上是個天生好手。

senses.en: having a skill or quality from birth
senses.pattern: a natural leader / a natural athlete / a natural talent for music / natural ability
senses.example: Calm and confident under pressure, Aaron is a [[natural]] leader whom the whole team trusts.
senses.example_zh: 亞倫在壓力下沉著又有自信，是個天生的領袖，全隊都信任他。

gsat.sentence: However, according to a wide array of scientific and sociological research, creativity is less a sign of rare genius than a [[natural]] human potential.

senses.en: to meet people who may be useful to your career
senses.pattern: network with professionals / a chance to network / a networking event
senses.example: The job fair gives graduates a chance to [[network]] with managers from different industries.
senses.example_zh: 就業博覽會讓畢業生有機會與各產業的主管建立人脈。

senses.en: (of an idea) to come into someone's mind
senses.pattern: occur to sb / it occurred to me that / it never occurred to me
senses.example: It never [[occurred]] to me that my joke might hurt her feelings.
senses.example_zh: 我從沒想到我的玩笑可能會傷了她的心。
senses.note: 主詞是念頭：sth occurs to sb

senses.en: to exist or be found somewhere
senses.pattern: occur naturally / occur in nature / occur widely / occur in the wild
senses.example: This rare mineral [[occurs]] naturally in only a few volcanic regions of the world.
senses.example_zh: 這種稀有礦物只天然存在於世界上少數幾個火山地區。

gsat.sentence: One day, an idea [[occurred]] to Art Fry.
Such dimples tend to [[occur]] in families, and are assumed to be an inherited feature.

senses.en: original; not coming from something else
senses.pattern: primary sources / primary data / primary colors / primary research
senses.example: Diaries and letters are [[primary]] sources that show historians how ordinary people really lived.
senses.example_zh: 日記和書信是第一手的資料，讓歷史學家了解一般人實際的生活樣貌。

senses.en: an election in which a party chooses its candidate
senses.pattern: win a primary / a presidential primary / a primary election
senses.example: In the United States, each major party holds [[primaries]] to choose its candidate for president.
senses.example_zh: 在美國，各大政黨都會舉行黨內初選，以選出總統候選人。

senses.en: fresh fruit and vegetables grown on farms
senses.pattern: fresh produce / local produce / organic produce / farm produce
senses.example: The restaurant buys all its [[produce]] from small farms within thirty kilometers of the city.
senses.example_zh: 這家餐廳所有的農產品都購自城市方圓三十公里內的小農場。
senses.note: 名詞重音在第一音節，不可數

senses.en: to show or bring out something for others to see
senses.pattern: produce a ticket / produce one's passport / produce evidence
senses.example: The guard refused to let us in until we [[produced]] our student ID cards.
senses.example_zh: 警衛直到我們出示學生證，才肯讓我們進去。

gsat.sentence: The local farmers’ market is popular as it offers a variety of fresh seasonal [[produce]] to people in the community.

senses.en: to intend to do something
senses.pattern: propose to do sth / propose doing sth / how do you propose to do sth
senses.example: How do you [[propose]] to finish the science project on time if you keep putting it off?
senses.example_zh: 如果你一直拖延，你打算怎麼準時完成這個科學專題？
senses.note: 較正式；後接 to V 或 V-ing

senses.en: to ask someone to marry you
senses.pattern: propose to sb / propose to one's girlfriend / propose on one knee
senses.example: He [[proposed]] to his girlfriend on the beach where they had first met five years earlier.
senses.example_zh: 他在五年前兩人初次相遇的海灘上向女友求婚。
senses.note: 名詞 proposal 也可指「求婚」

senses.en: to make a rule or control less strict
senses.pattern: relax the rules / relax restrictions / relax controls / relax a ban
senses.example: The school decided to [[relax]] its dress code and allow students to wear sneakers on Fridays.
senses.example_zh: 學校決定放寬服裝規定，允許學生星期五穿運動鞋。

senses.en: twenty; in the plural, a large number
senses.pattern: scores of people / scores of fans / scores of letters
senses.example: [[Scores]] of volunteers showed up to clean the beach after the oil spill.
senses.example_zh: 漏油事件後，大批志工前來清理海灘。

senses.en: written music, or the music for a film
senses.pattern: a film score / a musical score / read a score / compose the score
senses.example: The composer spent two years writing the [[score]] for the animated film.
senses.example_zh: 那位作曲家花了兩年為這部動畫電影寫配樂。

senses.en: to choose something after thinking about it
senses.pattern: settle on a name / settle on a date / finally settle on sth
senses.example: After trying on a dozen dresses, she finally [[settled]] on a simple blue one for the dance.
senses.example_zh: 試穿了十幾件洋裝後，她最後選定一件簡單的藍色洋裝去參加舞會。
senses.note: 比較 settle for＝勉強接受

senses.en: to come down and rest on a surface
senses.pattern: dust settles / snow settles on sth / settle on a branch
senses.example: A thin layer of dust had [[settled]] on the piano that nobody had played for years.
senses.example_zh: 那架多年沒人彈的鋼琴上，已經落下一層薄薄的灰塵。

senses.en: to pay the money that you owe
senses.pattern: settle a bill / settle a debt / settle an account
senses.example: Please [[settle]] your hotel bill at the front desk before you leave for the airport.
senses.example_zh: 前往機場前，請先到櫃檯結清您的住宿費用。

gsat.sentence: After years of research and testing, he learned that synthetics worked best and eventually [[settled]] on heat-treated nylon, a strong and durable substance.
Standing on the seashore, we saw a flock of seagulls flying over the ocean before they glided down and [[settled]] on the water.

senses.en: something that makes you feel sad or disappointed
senses.pattern: it's a shame (that) / what a shame / it would be a shame to
senses.example: It is a [[shame]] that such a beautiful old theater will be torn down next month.
senses.example_zh: 這麼美麗的老戲院下個月就要拆除，真是件可惜的事。

senses.en: to make someone feel ashamed; to bring disgrace on
senses.pattern: shame sb into doing / shame one's family / be shamed by
senses.example: His classmates' hard work [[shamed]] him into finally starting his own part of the project.
senses.example_zh: 同學們的努力使他羞愧，終於開始做自己負責的那部分專題。
senses.note: 名詞片語 put … to shame＝使…相形見絀

senses.en: an organization of people with a shared interest
senses.pattern: a drama society / a historical society / join a society
senses.example: Lily joined the school's photography [[society]] to learn how to take better pictures of birds.
senses.example_zh: 莉莉加入學校的攝影社團，想學習如何把鳥拍得更好。

gsat.sentence: Last week Jay McCarroll and The HSUS (The Humane [[Society]] of the United States) made a bold fur-free statement on the runway, marking <u>a new chapter</u> for the fashion industry and animal protection.

senses.en: to put a soft substance over a surface
senses.pattern: spread butter on bread / spread jam on toast / spread glue evenly
senses.example: He [[spread]] a thick layer of peanut butter on his toast and ate it in three bites.
senses.example_zh: 他在吐司上抹了厚厚一層花生醬，三口就吃完了。
senses.note: 名詞可指「抹醬」，如 cheese spread

senses.en: to divide something over a period or among people
senses.pattern: spread the cost / spread the payments over / spread the risk / spread the workload
senses.example: The store lets customers [[spread]] the cost of a new laptop over twelve monthly payments.
senses.example_zh: 這家店讓顧客把新筆電的費用分攤成十二期，按月付款。

senses.en: to organize a public event or protest
senses.pattern: stage a protest / stage a strike / stage a demonstration
senses.example: Animal lovers [[staged]] a silent march through the city center to call for stricter laws against cruelty.
senses.example_zh: 愛護動物人士在市中心發動一場靜默遊行，呼籲制定更嚴格的反虐待動物法規。
senses.note: stage a comeback 指「東山再起」

senses.en: to put on a play or show for an audience
senses.pattern: stage a play / stage a musical / stage a concert
senses.example: The drama club will [[stage]] a Shakespeare comedy at the end of the semester.
senses.example_zh: 戲劇社將在學期末上演一齣莎士比亞喜劇。

senses.en: a continuous area of land or period of time
senses.pattern: a stretch of road / a stretch of coastline / for long stretches / at a stretch
senses.example: This [[stretch]] of the river is popular with families because the water is shallow and calm.
senses.example_zh: 這一段河流很受家庭歡迎，因為水淺而平靜。

senses.en: to spread over a large area or long time
senses.pattern: stretch for miles / stretch from A to B / stretch back to
senses.example: Rice fields [[stretch]] as far as the eye can see on both sides of the railway.
senses.example_zh: 鐵路兩側的稻田一路綿延，一望無際。

senses.en: to use nearly all of someone's money or resources
senses.pattern: be stretched to the limit / stretch the budget / be stretched thin
senses.example: The sudden flood of patients [[stretched]] the small hospital's resources to the limit.
senses.example_zh: 突然湧入的病患使這家小醫院的資源吃緊到了極限。

gsat.sentence: Now, however, men have developed huge fishing nets that form underwater “walls” that [[stretch]] for miles.
With a continuous 3 km [[stretch]] of golden sand, the beach attracts artists around the world each summer to create amazing sculptures with its fine soft sand.

senses.en: to think that something is important or precious
senses.pattern: value sb's opinion / value friendship / be highly valued / value A over B
senses.example: A good coach [[values]] effort and teamwork more than the final score.
senses.example_zh: 好教練重視努力與團隊合作，勝過最後的比數。

senses.en: beliefs about what is right and important in life
senses.pattern: family values / traditional values / moral values / share the same values
senses.example: Although the two friends grew up in different countries, they share many of the same [[values]].
senses.example_zh: 這兩位朋友雖然在不同的國家長大，卻有許多相同的價值觀。

gsat.sentence: Paintings with white-toothed smiles emerged after the 1700s, with the gradual rise of a culture that [[valued]] perception and responsiveness.
A search for African American [[values]].

senses.en: to consider something carefully before deciding
senses.pattern: weigh the pros and cons / weigh A against B / weigh (up) the options / weigh the risks
senses.example: You should [[weigh]] the pros and cons carefully before you decide to quit the school team.
senses.example_zh: 在決定退出校隊之前，你應該仔細權衡利弊得失。

senses.en: to make someone feel worried or sad
senses.pattern: weigh on sb's mind / weigh heavily on sb / weigh on sb's conscience
senses.example: The argument with his best friend [[weighed]] on his mind throughout the long weekend.
senses.example_zh: 和最好的朋友吵架這件事，整個連假都壓在他的心頭。

quiz.stem: To protest against the plan to cut down the old trees, local residents ______ a peaceful demonstration in front of the city hall last Sunday.
quiz.explain_zh: stage＝發動、舉行（抗議）。居民在市政府前舉行和平示威。

quiz.stem: Online orders ______ for more than half of the restaurant's sales last year, so the owner decided to hire two more delivery workers.
quiz.explain_zh: account＝占（比例）。網路訂單占餐廳去年營業額的一半以上。

quiz.stem: As the number of new infections kept falling, health officials decided to ______ travel restrictions and reopen the border to tourists.
quiz.explain_zh: relax＝放寬（規定、限制）。感染人數下降，官員放寬旅遊限制。

quiz.stem: Worried that graduation trips were becoming too expensive for some families, the school placed a ______ of five thousand dollars on the cost per student.
quiz.explain_zh: ceiling＝上限。學校為畢業旅行每位學生的費用設定五千元上限。

quiz.stem: Before choosing a university, Hannah carefully ______ the advantages of living at home against the excitement of studying in a big city.
quiz.explain_zh: weigh＝權衡。選大學前，她仔細權衡住家裡的好處與到大城市念書的吸引力。

quiz.stem: In a ______ of fear and distrust, few workers dared to report the safety problems they had noticed at the factory.
quiz.explain_zh: climate＝風氣、氛圍。在恐懼與不信任的氛圍下，很少工人敢舉報安全問題。

quiz.stem: From the way Ms. Chen kept looking at her watch, I ______ that she was in a hurry to leave the meeting.
quiz.explain_zh: gather＝推斷。看陳老師頻頻看錶，我推斷她急著離開會議。

quiz.stem: Drivers are advised to slow down on this ______ of the highway, where thick fog often appears without warning in winter.
quiz.explain_zh: stretch＝一段（路程）。這一段公路冬天常突然起濃霧，駕駛應減速。

quiz.stem: Living alone after retirement, Mr. Wang adopted a dog from the shelter because he wanted some ______ in his quiet apartment.
quiz.explain_zh: company＝陪伴。王先生退休後獨居，想要有狗作伴。

quiz.stem: Lifeguards warned the swimmers to stay near the shore because a powerful ______ could easily carry them far out to sea.
quiz.explain_zh: current＝水流。強勁的水流可能輕易把泳客帶到外海。
